trajectory_summary: The call opens warm with a self-motivated, cooperative customer and stays cooperative throughout, but the rep never locks the two required documents (bill and roof shot) live, leaving the appointment structurally conditional. Energy did not leak from resistance — there was none — but the call ends with unresolved capture items pushed entirely onto the customer's follow-through after the call.
outcome_dispute: This should be tagged tentative, not booked: the rep explicitly states 'I would need the the picture of the roof and then the utility bill before I can put you in the schedule' at 05:23, meaning the 9:30 slot is conditional on documents that were never captured on the call.
